summary: Iteration 65 — Full backend + frontend testing of SpotYou group chat access control. All 12/12 backend tests pass. All 4/4 frontend UI features verified. Backend: join sets active, leave sets blocked, non-member 403, blocked can read, rejoin resets to active. Frontend: Groupe button hidden for non-members, visible for members, blocked banner shown with correct text for former members, input bar visible for active members.
critical_code_review_comments: The going route (POST /api/spot-you/{id}/going) also auto-adds participant to group conv — this is correct behavior and consistent with join.

The owner of pt_demo013 (Streetball 3x3 - République) is user_demo003 (Camille Durand), not coach@winek.app (Sophie Martin / user_coach001). Test credentials provided said 'coach = SpotYou owner' but this was inaccurate for pt_demo013. The owner UI (owner-action-bar, owner-group-chat-btn) would only show for Camille Durand. No code issue — just a documentation mismatch in test credentials.
Blocked users still appear in conversation_participants list (read-only) — correct design. The WS endpoint correctly rejects blocked users (status != active check on line 376-382 of chat_routes.py).
No cleanup of blocked participant rows when a SpotYou is deleted — minor concern for data hygiene but no functional impact.
